formatVersion.description: Version of the example enrichment format.

operation.description: Explicitly identifies this payload as an update to existing words.

allOf.description: Exact Japanese form inserted at the {{word}} marker when the answer is revealed. Include the complete conjugated form needed by this example. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.
Optional explanation shown after the answer, such as a useful collocation, register note, or nuance.

Japanese example sentence containing exactly one {{word}} marker where the example answer should be inserted. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.
Natural English phrase corresponding specifically to the missing Japanese word. It is inserted into the translation template and highlighted during practice.

Natural English translation of the complete Japanese example containing exactly one {{target}} marker where translationTarget should be inserted. Include all surrounding spaces and punctuation in the template.
Examples to append to an existing word. A malformed example rejects this word while other valid words remain importable.

Existing Japanese word or expression to enrich. Use the exact text produced by the library export. Furigana notation: add each reading in square brackets immediately after the character it belongs to, with no spaces, for example 資[し]金[きん]. Do not group readings after a multi-character word. For kana-only words, write the word as-is.
Existing words whose example catalogs should be expanded. Each word is processed independently.

title: Word example enrichment JSON
description: JSON payload for appending practice examples to words already in the library.
